target_runtime.note: Load each SKILL.md and its JSON contracts from the experiment harness. Do not install this pack into Codex skill discovery.

external_tools.name: retrieve_provisions
external_tools.note: The harness fixes the retriever, Top-k, fusion, and reranker profile per experiment.

external_tools.name: validate_citation_integrity
external_tools.note: This deterministic tool checks citation identity and linkage, not legal interpretation or entailment.

state_reducer.accepted_provision_ids: Derive from validated S2 evidence_links whose relation is supports or partially_supports and whose evidence assessment is not conflicting; never accept a provision absent from candidate_provisions.
state_reducer.next_action: Choose only in the harness policy from validated RunState, critical blockers, remaining budget, duplicate-query checks, and no-progress state.

invariants: Skills never call one another or tools directly.
S1 never assesses coverage or chooses a policy action.
S2 never retrieves, generates an answer, emits accepted_provision_ids, or chooses a policy action.
S3 runs only after GENERATE authorization and cites accepted provisions only.
ABSTAIN bypasses S3 and citation integrity checking and returns a structured withholding reason.
Execution and contract failures use EXECUTION_FAILURE rather than a coverage-policy action.
